PARTIAL CLOSURE — shift 5, 2026-11-18 17:0xZ. Option C is confirmed working (not just proposed), and the dispatch-critical set is now fully owned. Narrowing this card rather than deleting it.

WHAT IS PROVEN (two independent creates, `profiles` read back with `get_task`, not inferred from the create response):
| Card | created | `profiles` after read-back |
|---|---|---|
| `5608c889` | 17:00:34Z | `["qa_automation"]` ✅ |
| `7937f9cb` (this card) | 16:58:36Z | `["ProjectManager"]` ✅ |
Ownership set at creation persists. `update_task(profiles=...)` cannot set it afterwards (card `a5f95606`). Both directions verified today.

NEW DEFECT FOUND WHILE CHECKING THIS CARD — and it is relevant to the sweep: `create_task` without an explicit `status` persisted `status: ""` on `5608c889`, i.e. a card belonging to none of the five canonical states (rendered `-` in listings, and invisible to any status filter). I corrected that card to `todo`. **When you re-create an ownerless card, pass `status` EXPLICITLY (`status="todo"`) — omitting it produces an invalid card.** Recorded on `a5f95606` as the second defect in the same field-handling path.

DISPATCH-CRITICAL SET — verified owned, leave alone:
- `cdff59e2` → `software_developer` (ran twice, real work)
- `d8534b12` → `software_developer` (14 messages, real analysis)
- `e816cc41` → `software_developer`
- `f8e10ad1` → `project_manager`
- `5608c889` → `qa_automation` (the card this card was created to unblock)
- `4a30693e` → **still `[]`, and that is now CORRECT**: it is superseded by `5608c889` and is kept only as the record of the code written. Do not re-create it, do not re-dispatch it.

REMAINING SCOPE (what this card still owes at its 19 Nov 08:00Z wake): the ~14 cards that are NOT dispatch-critical — those blocked on git/tar (`88d57bdd`, `9ce4e7ef`, `ab4072b9`, `39a2d6a4`) or on a policy decision (`f8e10ad1`). Read their `profiles` with `get_task`; re-create ONLY the ones you are about to dispatch. Do not bulk re-create cards that no one can run yet — a card that cannot execute does not become runnable by gaining an owner, it only becomes a card with an owner that cannot execute.

TIME-BOX: 15 minutes. If unclear, record what you measured and escalate. Do not loop.
